Every file that names `PlanId` in a type annotation, type argument, `Record` key, or import is listed below. I found these with a text search for `PlanId` across the repo, excluding `node_modules` and `.next`. That covers test files and the `src/types/billing.ts` definition itself, since the new plan has to be added there.

I left out two groups that match the text but don't reference the type in code:
- `corpus-manifest.json` and `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` contain `PlanId` only inside signature strings, which are documentation data rather than compiled references. They may need a refresh if the manifest is regenerated, but they don't need code changes.

Grouped by area:
- **Type definitions:** `src/types/billing.ts` (the union and `PLAN_IDS`), `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/feature-flag.ts`, `src/types/organization.ts`
- **Config and schema:** `src/config/plan-limits.ts` (`PLAN_LIMITS` and `PLAN_ORDER` are keyed by `PlanId`), `src/schemas/billing.ts`
- **Server:** `src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts`, `src/server/services/billing-service.ts`, `src/server/db/seed.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`
- **UI:** `src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx` (`PLAN_BLURBS` is a `Record<PlanId, string>`), `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx`, `src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx`
- **Tests and fixtures:** `tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts`, `tests/config/nav.test.ts`, `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`, `tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts`, `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`

The `Record<PlanId, …>` maps in `src/config/plan-limits.ts` and `pricing-grid.tsx` will fail to compile until the new plan is added to them. I did not open or edit any of these files, since this was a discovery task.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/organization.ts, src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/schemas/billing.ts, src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/lib/rate-limit.ts, src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx, src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx, tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts
